We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 664985) to the molecule. We have the target molecule from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 answer: list of three SMILES (possible products? Actually those are likely the product molecules? The question: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-4 to the molecule below?" The answer gave three SMILES each inside list: each is a product? The template search gave a mapped_rxn: product>>precursor? The mapped_rxn: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO>>C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". So forward direction: product (left) to precursor (right). Actually mapped_rxn shows product>>precursor (since they reversed?). The template is retrosynthetic, so applying to product yields precursors. So we need to apply template_id 664985 to the target molecule (the product). The product SMILES is the left side of mapped_rxn: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". That's one of the three from earlier list. The other two are variations with silyl group on different O? Actually they are different isomers. The template likely can be applied to each of those three product SMILES, yielding possible precursors. We need to return all possible precursors (list of lists). So we need to apply template to each product SMILES using apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template for each product SMILES with template_id "664985".
